title: Every 5-to-4 local projection of the published 4x5 grid-state range is spanned by its complex Schmidt-rank-at-most-two vectors
reference: https://arxiv.org/html/2509.07086v1, Krebs and Gachechiladze, Eq. (11), Theorem 5
target_and_scope: For every full-rank complex linear map from the second local factor C^5 to C^4 of the published 4x5 state's range, the projected range satisfies the basic Schmidt-rank-two spanning range criterion. This is a new written obstruction to using ANY linear range-annihilator certificate for that 4x4 projection. It does NOT give an SN<=2 decomposition, a counterexample, a global theorem, or any conclusion for nonprojected 4x4 states.
source_range: S={M(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,i,h)=[[a,b,c,0,h],[d,a,b,0,0],[e,-d,a,f,0],[g,0,i,e,c]] : all nine parameters in C}. Let B_j be the coefficient matrix of variable j. For any full-column-rank P in C^(5x4), the projected range is S P. It is the actual range of the locally projected published PSD state, since range(A rho A*)=A range(rho) for rho>=0.
basis_observation: All eight basis matrices B_b,B_c,B_d,B_e,B_f,B_g,B_i,B_h have ordinary complex rank at most 2: b and d each occupy two entries, c and e each occupy two entries, and f,g,i,h each occupy one entry. Rank cannot increase on right multiplication by P. Thus all eight projected B_j P are rank<=2. The remaining B_a has rank 3 before projection.
construction_quantifier: For EVERY full-rank P, choose a nonzero covector s=(u,v,w,x,y) with im(P)=ker(s). There exists M0 in S with a=1 and rank(M0 P)=2. Full algebraic construction follows, so no generic-position restriction or real-only approximation is used.
proof_nontrivial_first_three: If (u,v,w)!=(0,0,0), choose nonzero alpha,beta,gamma satisfying alpha*w-gamma*u=beta*(v-beta). If (u,w)!=(0,0), choose beta nonzero and not v, and solve the one linear equation with both alpha,gamma nonzero (a finite set of choices is avoided). If u=w=0, v!=0, take beta=v and alpha=gamma=1. Put b=(w-gamma)/beta, d=(u-alpha)/beta, f=x/gamma, h=y/alpha, and c=e=g=i=0. The first three rows of M0 are [1,b,0,0,h], [d,1,b,0,0], [0,-d,1,f,0], and the last row is zero. Their leading 3x3 determinant is exactly 1. Direct substitution gives s=alpha*r0+beta*r1+gamma*r2. Therefore M0 has rank 3 and its rowspace contains nonzero s; restriction of that 3-dimensional rowspace to ker(s) has rank 2. Hence rank(M0 P)=2.
proof_last_two_only: If u=v=w=0 then (x,y)!=(0,0). Set a=1,c=y,e=x,f=g=i=h=0. When x!=0 choose d=0 and b with b^2=(xy-1)/x; when x=0 choose b=0 and d with d^2=1/y. Such choices exist over C. The leading 3x3 determinant is 1+b^2*x-y*d^2-xy=0 and its leading 2x2 minor is 1, so the first three rows have rank 2. They occupy the first three columns, while the fourth row is nonzero s, supported in the last two columns. Thus M0 has rank 3, and restriction to ker(s) gives rank(M0 P)=2.
full_span_proof: For every M in S, write M=a M0 + sum_{j!=a}(coefficient_j(M)-a coefficient_j(M0))*B_j. After multiplying by P, this expresses MP as a complex linear combination of the nine projected rank<=2 matrices M0 P and B_j P. Each belongs to S P, so S P is exactly the linear span of its own complex Schmidt-rank<=2 vectors. No assumption on P beyond rank 4 is used.

exact_experiments.method: Bounded parameter values {0,1,-1}; exact integer 3x3-minor rank<=2 test and independent Fraction Gaussian elimination on flattened matrices. Search stops on reaching full span or after 3^9 assignments. The nine source basis images separately compute the projected range dimension.
exact_experiments.bounded_search_miss_repaired: For normal (1,2,3,4,5), the finite {0,1,-1} search missed the ninth direction, not a theorem failure. The universal formula gives (a,b,c,d,e,f,g,i,h)=(1,1,0,0,0,2,0,0,5). Exact recheck produced projected rows [-1,-3,-4,0], [1,1,0,0], [0,1,2,0], [0,0,0,0]; all 16 3x3 minors vanish, and Fraction span elimination found it independent of the previous eight, completing dimension 9.

status: Written proof plus the explicitly described finite exact checks; no independent written referee, formal/kernel proof, general 4x4 Schmidt-number result or separate novelty clearance. The result strengthens the exact same-source obstruction in frontier-20261028-grid-projection-obstruction-v1.json (SHA256 8d72e6ecdf0eb6a01fcddfb0c75eda3272847883f575c1dbd31bee5b40942c84).
